dimension_justifications.soundness: The protocol framing and printed summary arithmetic are coherent, but every empirical result is explicitly source-reported and all underlying records, implementations, stochastic traces, registrations, and analysis objects are absent. Consequently, the central +13.0 pp result and all secondary results cannot be independently audited or reproduced; this is a cannot_verify finding, not evidence that the reported effects are false.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The paper is unusually explicit about endpoint hierarchy, estimand boundaries, unavailable evidence, and prohibited interpretations. Tables are legible, terminology is consistent, anonymity is preserved, and the five-page main text is within the nine-page limit. Evaluation is nevertheless obstructed by opaque E10–E15 identifiers and repeated reliance on an unavailable source manuscript.
dimension_justifications.contribution: The finite-pool audit framing and separation of nominal-draw matching from forward-call-count sensitivity are potentially useful, but the work introduces no new scorer, studies one checkpoint/task construction, and supplies no independently auditable empirical evidence. Its decision-relevant significance therefore remains narrow and uncertain.

paper_summary: The paper presents a bounded comparison of five multiple-choice scoring protocols for LLaDA-8B-Instruct on constructed four-choice GSM8K pools. Its sole source-manuscript-designated primary endpoint reports a +13.0 percentage-point s_conf versus mc_uniform contrast on n=400 under nominal matched-L draws; post-selected and high-budget sensitivities report +13.0 and +9.0 points. On a fresh n=819 pool, fixed left-to-right reveal reportedly exceeds s_conf by 5.62 points in aggregate but reverses at answer position 0. The estimands are carefully limited to finite pools conditional on unavailable scorer realizations. Every empirical number is labeled source-reported/cannot-verify, and the package contains none of the item records, code, traces, registrations, or analysis artifacts underlying the results.
strongest_verified_contribution: The strongest verifiable contribution is the clear decomposition of each scorer into schedule, feedback, masking, estimator, and call-accounting choices, together with an explicit finite-pool, realized-schedule estimand and endpoint hierarchy. All manifest-listed file hashes match, and the deltas and exact two-sided McNemar p-values reconstructable from printed n and b/c counts agree with Tables 3, 5, and 6. These checks establish internal reporting coherence, not the truth of the experiments.
strengths: The paper sharply limits its claims: it disclaims component-level causality, stochastic-policy expectations, actual-resource equivalence, and cross-bed generalization.
The sole primary endpoint, post-selected sensitivity, robustness point, and secondary analyses are clearly separated in Table 1 and consistently described thereafter.
Printed effect sizes are arithmetically consistent with the displayed discordant counts; the displayed exact McNemar p-values are also reproducible from those counts.
Section 6 and Appendices A–E accurately disclose the missing records, schedules, implementation, registration, environment, and citation-audit scope rather than implying reproducibility.
The PDF is anonymous, visually clean across all eight pages, within the main-text page limit, and contains an explicit author AI-assistance disclosure.
Every file hash listed in MANIFEST.json matches the corresponding frozen file.
questions: Can the authors provide an anonymous E10–E15 crosswalk and the item-level records, scores, predictions, logs, and hashes needed to recompute every reported number?

Which exact GSM8K split and item identifiers were used, how were exclusions and pool assignments determined, and what machine-check establishes n=400/fresh-n=819 disjointness and answer-position balance?
What are the byte-exact prompts, candidate strings, LLaDA checkpoint and tokenizer revisions, software/library versions, hardware, and complete scoring configurations?
Can the exact random-mask subsets and reveal orders be supplied together with a stable RNG specification? How will the process-sensitive string-hash schedule be replayed bit-for-bit?

What exact procedures generated each confidence interval, the fresh-versus-pilot z=2.41 comparison, and the ten-test Holm family? Can the complete hypothesis ledger, adjusted values, code, and timestamped registration be supplied?

Why does the citation lock identify the Nie et al. 2025 LLaDA paper as NeurIPS 2025 while the PDF bibliography identifies it as ICML 2025, and can the lock be synchronized with all references actually present?

issues.location: PDF p.2, Section 3, lines 104–107; p.3, Equation 1 and lines 133–147; p.4, Section 5.1 and Table 4; p.6, Appendix A, lines 297–301
issues.observed_evidence: The primary random-mask reference is conditional on unavailable mask draws, and the random-order result uses one unavailable schedule. Appendix A states that the nominal random-order seed is insufficient because schedule generation depended on a process-sensitive string hash. No exact seed, RNG algorithm/state, mask subsets, or reveal orders are supplied.
issues.why_it_matters: Even the deliberately conditional estimands cannot be replayed without their conditioning traces. The random-order result also cannot characterize a schedule-family expectation from one realization, although the paper responsibly avoids claiming that expectation.
issues.required_fix: Publish the exact per-item/per-candidate mask subsets and reveal orders, RNG implementation and state, seed derivation, and deterministic serialization. Replace process-sensitive hashing with a stable specified generator. If an expectation over randomness is later claimed, add multiple independently seeded realizations and appropriate aggregation.
issues.verification_test: Replay the released traces twice in fresh processes and environments and require bit-identical schedules, mask subsets, scores, and predictions. Separately verify that any across-realization claim is computed from predeclared independent seeds rather than the single stored schedule.
issues.evidence_needed: Persisted stochastic traces, stable RNG specification, seeds and states, serialization hashes, and—only for expectation claims—multi-realization outputs.

Clearly distinguish any analyses absent from the registration as post hoc.

issues.evidence_needed: Paired correctness/score records, analysis scripts, bootstrap draws or seeds, complete hypothesis ledger, adjusted results, and timestamped registration object.

ethics_concerns: No material human-subject, privacy, safety, or deployment ethics concern is apparent from this bounded benchmark study. The central concern is research-evidence provenance rather than an established ethics violation.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control. It used only the frozen submission materials for evidentiary judgments and did not use prior reviews, author notes, repository history, or internet sources.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: A hash-verified anonymous E10–E15 bundle that allows exact independent recomputation of every reported table and statistic.
Executable scoring and analysis code with exact prompts, item/choice manifests, checkpoint and tokenizer revisions, configurations, and an environment lock.
Persisted mask and reveal-order traces with stable deterministic replay, plus multiple realizations if any stochastic-policy expectation is claimed.
A timestamped preregistration, complete multiplicity ledger, adjusted values, and deterministic interval/test procedures matching the released paired records.
A synchronized, complete primary-source citation audit resolving the Nie et al. venue conflict and covering all references.
Independent reproduction showing that the primary +13.0 pp result and key construction/position findings survive the documented pipeline.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Recomputation fails to recover the reported accuracies, discordant counts, effect sizes, intervals, or exact tests.
Sampling manifests reveal overlap, leakage, undocumented exclusions, or materially different pool construction or answer-position balance.
Instrumented traces contradict the reported arm definitions or forward-call accounting.
Registration timestamps or contents show that the sole-primary designation followed outcome inspection.
Stable multi-realization evaluation shows that the reported single mask/schedule realization is exceptional while the manuscript retains broader language.
Citation verification shows that closest-work or mechanism claims are unsupported by the cited primary sources.
review_limitations: External literature and metadata were not checked; citation judgments are restricted to the supplied partial citation lock and internal consistency.

No executable code, dataset manifest, item-level record, stochastic trace, registration, or E10–E15 artifact was available, so inability to verify must not be read as proof that the reported results are false.

All eight PDF pages were visually inspected. Independent numerical checks were limited to quantities reconstructable from printed summaries, including hashes, effect arithmetic, exact McNemar p-values, subgroup count reconciliation, and candidate-length totals.
